changelog:
Initial release of crypto-signals-router: automated 24/7 routing and orchestration for crypto signals operations.

- Enables multi-agent routing for trade signals, market data, news analysis, x402 wallet/payments, Telegram publishing, and system health.
- Defines and documents agent map, triggers, and routing logic for common user tasks.
- Orchestrates full signals cycle every 30 minutes, with watchdog checks every 5 minutes and weekly summaries.
- Provides detailed runtime setup guides for OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, and Linux/systemd services.
- Centralizes state, logs, and environment configuration for reliable and auditable crypto signals operations.
summary: Routes to the appropriate agent in the crypto-signals-plugin team. Trigger when the user asks about crypto trade signals, market analysis, price data, crypto news sentiment, Telegram channel publishing, x402 wallet management, signal performance, or anything related to running an automated crypto signals operation. Lean toward delegation — if crypto signals, market data fetching, news analysis, x402 payments for APIs, or Telegram channel management is any part of the task, route it to the appropriate agent below.
